verdict.rationale: Token2 makes hardware security keys, so certified, ruggedized models are a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions FIPS 140 validation, Common Criteria certification, or water or crush resistance for any Token2 model. The demo tool's lookup of 'certified authenticators' is a general authenticator lookup, not evidence of FIPS or CC certification of Token2's own hardware, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, certified models exist for regulated environments — FIPS 140 validated or Common Criteria certified — with documented durability (water/crush resistance)
